notes: Values captured via getComputedStyle on real HeroUI <Button> instances rendered on the v2 docs page. The v3 docs (heroui.com) render prose-layout buttons styled with fumadocs CSS, not the HeroUI component — v2 is the authoritative source for current HeroUI Button styling.
Theme tokens (bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, etc.) are Tailwind semantic tokens; resolved RGB values below are the HeroUI *default* theme.
Default font weight is 400 (font-normal) — HeroUI does NOT bold its button label. subpixel-antialiased is always on.
Default radius is 'medium' (12px) at size=md. Size changes radius: sm→8px, md→12px, lg→14px. radius prop overrides: none=0, sm=8, md=12, lg=14, full≈pill.
minWidth tracks size: sm=64 (min-w-16), md=80 (min-w-20), lg=96 (min-w-24). Height tracks size: sm=32, md=40, lg=48. Gap: sm/md=8, lg=12.
Flat variant uses bg = color/20 (alpha 0.2) and fg = color-600 (a lighter tint of the color). Primary example: bg oklab(.567 -.044 -.205 / .2), color rgb(102,170,249).

Shadow variant layers: solid color bg + shadow-lg with color at alpha 0.4 — resolved boxShadow: 'oklab(<color>/.4) 0 10px 15px -3px, oklab(<color>/.4) 0 4px 6px -4px' (5 empty tailwind ring placeholders precede it).
Ghost variant is identical to bordered at rest; on data-[hover=true] it flips to solid (bg-<color>, text-<color>-foreground).
Faded variant = bg-default-100 (rgb(39,39,42) dark) + border-default (rgb(63,63,70)) + text-<color>. Border width 'medium' = 2px.
Bordered/ghost border width is 2px (border-medium). Light/solid/flat/shadow have no border.
Default outline (focus reset): 'rgba(0,0,0,0) solid 1.5px'. On data-[focus-visible=true]: outline 2px solid var(--heroui-focus) with outline-offset 2px and z-index 10.
Pressed state (data-[pressed=true]) applies scale(0.97) via transform-gpu — there is no separate :active opacity change.

Hover is variant-specific and implemented with data-[hover=true] class rules, not :hover. For solid: bg opacity lifts toward color-500/90 (alpha ~0.9). For bordered/light/ghost: bg becomes color/20 flat. For flat: bg opacity shifts (color/50). For shadow: lifts via scale + shadow. A universal fallback is opacity-hover=0.9 on solid colors.

isDisabled: opacity 0.5, pointer-events none, cursor stays 'pointer' in computed style (Tailwind sets cursor-not-allowed via class, but pointer-events:none short-circuits it — the real UX is no-interaction).

isLoading: same visual as disabled (opacity 0.5, pointer-events none) with an added Spinner child rendered before children; data-loading='true' is set on the root. The label remains visible alongside the spinner.

base.transition: transform 0.25s, scale 0.25s, color 0.25s, background 0.25s, background-color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s, text-decoration-color 0.25s, fill 0.25s, stroke 0.25s, opacity 0.25s

bordered.rule: bg = transparent, fg = color.bg (text-<color>), border = 2px solid color.bg

light.rule: bg = transparent, fg = color.bg (text-<color>), border = 0; hover adds bg = color/20

flat.rule: bg = color at alpha 0.20, fg = color-600 (lighter-on-dark tint). On hover: bg alpha 0.30-0.50.

faded.rule: bg = default-100 (rgb(39,39,42) dark / rgb(244,244,245) light), fg = text-<color>, border = 2px solid default (rgb(63,63,70)).

shadow.rule: Same as solid + boxShadow 'shadow-lg shadow-<color>/40' — two-layer drop shadow tinted by color at alpha 0.4.

ghost.rule: Identical to bordered at rest; on hover flips to solid (bg=color.bg, fg=color.fg, border stays same color).

hover.implementation: data-[hover=true] class variants per variant: solid→bg at color/90; bordered→bg = color/20; light→bg = color/20; flat→bg = color/50; shadow→scale/shadow shift; ghost→flips to solid (bg=color, fg=color-foreground).

active.note: uses react-aria press events, not CSS :active

disabled.cursor: not-allowed (via class, though pointer-events:none takes precedence)
disabled.implementation: native [disabled] attr set; Tailwind disabled:opacity-disabled (0.5) + disabled:cursor-not-allowed + disabled:pointer-events-none

loading.spinner: A <Spinner> child is rendered alongside the label (label is NOT replaced/hidden). Spinner color inherits from text color and size tracks button size.
loading.notes: Visually identical to isDisabled but with a spinner prepended and data-loading='true' on root.

transition: transform 0.25s, scale 0.25s, color 0.25s, background 0.25s, background-color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s, text-decoration-color 0.25s, fill 0.25s, stroke 0.25s, opacity 0.25s
